<a name="config.module_site..siteConfig"></a>

### site~siteConfig : <code>SiteConfig</code>
Editable appearance configuration.

Use `null` for `theme` to retain the selected style's native palette. When
`defaultMode` is omitted or set to `"system"`, the browser preference wins.

**Kind**: inner constant of [<code>site</code>](#config.module_site)

### site~STYLE\_LOADERS
Lazy stylesheet loaders keyed by supported UI Style Kit preset.

<a name="config.module_site..loadConfiguredStyle"></a>

### site~loadConfiguredStyle([config], [styleLoaders]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;unknown&gt;</code>
Load only the stylesheet selected by the site configuration.

**Kind**: inner method of [<code>site</code>](#config.module_site)
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;unknown&gt;</code> - Loaded stylesheet module.
**Throws**:

- <code>Error</code> When the configured style has no registered stylesheet.


| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [config] | <code>SiteConfig</code> | Appearance configuration to load. |
| [styleLoaders] | <code>Object.&lt;string, function()&gt;</code> | Preset loader registry. |
